description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the Execution Accuracy of two logical synthesis modules across various evaluation categories. The horizontal category axis displays four labels ordered from left to right as Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The vertical value axis, labeled "Execution Accuracy," employs a linear scale that begins at 20 and extends to 60, with numeric tick labels spaced at regular intervals of 10 and corresponding light gray horizontal grid lines extending across the plot area. The chart features bars grouped by category, with each group containing two adjacent vertical bars. According to the legend positioned at the top center, the light blue bars on the left of each group represent "NatSQL," while the dark blue bars on the right represent "TA-SQL." Every bar is visually emphasized with an exact numerical annotation placed directly above its top edge. In the "Simple" category, the NatSQL bar has a value of 60.21, and the TA-SQL bar reaches 63.14, which is the tallest bar in the chart. For the "Moderate" category, the values are 39.64 for NatSQL and 48.60 for TA-SQL. In the "Challenging" category, the NatSQL bar represents 32.32, marking the shortest bar overall, while the TA-SQL bar reads 36.11. Lastly, the "Total" group indicates an accuracy of 51.35 for NatSQL and 56.19 for TA-SQL. The bar groups are arranged categorically by difficulty level followed by an aggregate total, rather than being sorted in strict ascending or descending numerical order.
